lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a regular grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, with a prominent vertical column of four distinct spots visible immediately behind the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating visible grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) in close proximity to the ventral-lateral surface and trailing the pectoral fin.
